body:
The local implementation keeps selected texture format, dimension and creating
device together, preserves cached-view and missing-state priorities, and retains
native validation causes. Connected repairs cover checked texture transfers,
compute observation and completion, renderer simulation sources and binding
ranges, and canonical card populations.

Cube shader rendering, face blits, direct copies, 2D blits and cached-view clears
observe native creation and recording before separate encoder-finalization and
submission checks. Sampler creation now preserves immediate native rejection
under the same configured policy. These operations add no GPU-completion wait.
Shader programs, packing, native defaults and existing fixture oracles remain
preserved. Documentation distinguishes actual mutable validation policy,
constructor defaults, browser handling and caller-installed error scopes.

Ownership of the connected #774 functions is resolved through the authorized
#780/#826 takeover and agreed whole-function split. All 83 GPU files have
independent Code, Rule and Comment source-review accounting, with no remaining
actionable finding in the bounded #826 native scope. This is not combined-graph
or compilation clearance.

The ten-file Creator cache/error-receiver family has been received exactly from
its canonical owner. It preserves initialization and material/clothing causes
and admits all mail images before publishing their assets/cache entry. Its
remaining material API dependency is explicit: the older local MetalImages
recipient still returns String and must be replaced by the canonical typed
material/maps family. Scalp texture-chain receiving is under review; the owner
is correcting one unsupported performance claim. Hair/geometry, generated
programs and extraction, physical/body/fitting/armor/engraving, readback,
remaining callers and final lock composition still require complete integration.

Current main is pinned at `990430b77a9f63548ffcb642074185f61ddb3322`; the published
head remains `d2e9f2f2984d33073386f0267a673fb7ac6478a3`. No new source checkpoint
has been pushed and no hosted checks have been requested for these repairs.
Validation uses existing tests only, with no newly authored tests, cases, test
helpers or assertions. Historical software-provider numerical failures, the
Creator process crash, and browser/hardware/performance limits remain qualified;
they are not verdicts on the current source. Final acceptance requires complete
thirteen-lens waves, independent Code/Rule/Comment reviews and required hosted
checks on one final pushed revision. The agent will not merge this PR.
